topic: Heat Energy: Sources, Transfer, and Safety
key_concepts: Energy is the ability to do work
The Sun is the principal source of energy for Earth
Energy transfer moves energy from place to place without changing form
Heat is the transfer of thermal energy due to temperature difference
Thermal energy is the energy inside something due to particle movement
Heat moves from warmer objects to cooler objects
Sources of heat energy include stoves, ovens, heaters, the sun, gas, oil, wood, and electr
Heat energy causes changes such as cooking food, melting ice, and heating rooms
Safety is important when dealing with heat sources and devices
Leaving cooking or charging devices unattended can be dangerous
